rows.transcript: My name is Ravi. I have a red ball. I play with my friend. We play in the park..

Asha lives near a big river. Every morning she goes to the river with her grandfather. He catches fish in a small boat. One day the boat had a hole. Water came inside inside and Asha was scared. Grandfather smiled and closed the the hole with mud and grass. They came back home safely. That night Asha told her friends about the brave boat..
